title: Cinema Sunday: Night at the Museum
seo_title: Cinema Sunday: Night at the Museum in Springfield, MO
description: Cinema Sunday is a free screening of Night at the Museum, in which security guard Larry Daley finds that an Egyptian curse brings the museum's animals to life after closing. It takes place Sunday, February 21, 2027 at 2:00 PM at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central E., Springfield, MO. Tickets are reserved by phone at 417-863-9491 or in person at the Gillioz Box Office starting February 1st, and reserved tickets must be redeemed at least 15 minutes before showtime.
